row.title: Watchdog lands the year-simulation, say-do and trajectory ledgers
row.body: The runway step wrote ops/yearsim*, ops/saydo*, ops/trajectory* and their site data, but the watchdog Record step never added them, so each run lost its own history. It now adds whichever exist (Q-REDMAIN-revert-lane second half; revertRedMain was already live).

title: Watchdog lands the year-simulation, say-do and trajectory ledgers
